name: Monte Carlo Simulation
when_to_use: The result depends on several uncertain variables with plausible ranges/distributions; generate thousands of random scenarios to estimate the distribution of the result and its risk.
notes: Tests thousands of random scenarios within plausible ranges to estimate the risk and variation of a result. Applications: cash-flow projection, project-duration estimation.

expected_input.question: What is the risk and variation range of a result, given that several inputs are uncertain?

pdca_use: Plan phase: project the risk/variation range of a result (e.g., duration, cost of an action) from explicit distributions provided by the planner — deterministic given the seed and parameters, does not learn patterns from data.

plain_explanation.purpose: Repeats a scenario with random draws thousands of times to see the range of possible outcomes.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When several factors are uncertain and you want the chance of each outcome.
plain_explanation.data_needed: Likely values (minimum, most likely, maximum) for each uncertainty.
plain_explanation.example: Estimate the chance of a project overrunning its deadline.
plain_explanation.diagram: draw values -> compute -> repeat 10,000x -> distribution of results
